model_interpretation.claim: Assigning one 32-lane warp to each target parallelizes its source traversal, reducing the per-target serial interaction path to roughly N/32 iterations per lane. The mapping also increases lane and block work per output and adds shuffle reductions, so small-size regressions are possible; official measurements across the three benchmark sizes must decide the outcome.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/launch.json","src/nbody_kernel.cu"],"retained":["Changed the launch chunk to 8 outputs for a 256-thread block, matching one 32-lane warp per target and the kernel's logical output index.","Partitioned source traversal by lane with a stride of 32, retained the baseline force expression, and reduced each force component with full-warp shuffle-down steps.","Restricted integration and output to lane zero; retained zero shared-memory staging and made the source-index increment safe near the signed-int limit."]}
